name: gaia-skill-heaven
description: The Claude Code plugin marketplace for gaia-skill-heaven — the Skill Heaven umbrella runtime brand. It ships claude-zero, the Skill Zero launcher door, while keeping /skill-hell framed as the live Hell summon door under the same umbrella.

plugins.name: claude-zero
plugins.description: Working prototype of the Claude Code door to Skill Zero under the Skill Heaven umbrella, actively tested for public use — /skill-zero owns boot-time off|low|med; the launcher also ships the axis commands /skill-heaven, /skill-hell, and /skill-ultra, with /skill-hell as the live Hell summon door. Interfaces may change. Built on skill-zero core.
